title: GradMent Event Envelope Schema
description: Standardized envelope wrapper for all events emitted into the GradMent Data Platform

event_id.description: Unique UUID v4 event identifier for client-side deduplication and idempotency.

event_name.description: Snake_case event identifier formatted as <object>_<action> (e.g. discipline_rated).

schema_version.description: Version integer for the event payload schema, starting at 1.

user_key.description: Salted SHA-256 hash of the user_id, or null if unauthenticated.

session_id.description: UUID v4 session identifier for session boundary grouping (fct_sessions).

event_ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the event occurred.

app_version.description: Semantic version of the GradMent app.
